_comment: Spirits (2026-11-13), Lingering Souls HOLE B2: TWO Souls in the graveyard, BOTH flashed back in one main ({1}{B} + {1}{B}; the two {B} from Godless Shrine and Watery Grave). Supreme Phantom (not sick) lords the tokens to 2/2. Opponent 10. The only T5 kill: T4 both flashbacks -> four 2/2 fliers, Phantom 1 (9); T5 1 + 8 = 9. One flashback per turn gives 1 + (1 + 4) = 6 by T5, kill T6. Before the fix the graveyard cast was one candidate per distinct NAME, so a plan held at most one Souls flashback at any budget (this fixture at budget 0 read win T6).
